title: CheckResult
description: One JSON object emitted by each check script on stdout. Enforced by Write-HealthResult at emit time; orchestrator re-validates on receipt.

id.description: Catalog identifier (kebab-case). Matches catalog/checks.jsonc id field.

category.description: High-level grouping used for report layout and severity_counts aggregation.

summary.description: One-line human summary. Shown in at-a-glance table and per-finding heading.

detail.description: Check-specific structured data. Rendered verbatim into report appendix. Depth must not exceed 10 for ConvertTo-Json round-trip safety.

commands.description: Reproduction commands the human can paste into a PowerShell prompt to re-derive the finding.

ran_successfully.description: False when the check returned UNKNOWN due to error, timeout, missing cmdlet, or access denied.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds inside the check. Must not exceed the orchestrator's 90s per-check budget.

notes.description: Caveats, reason for severity adjustment, missing-cmdlet context. Never used for primary findings - that's summary.

error.description: Populated iff ran_successfully is false. Exception message or tool error.

allOf.description: When ran_successfully is false, severity must be UNKNOWN and error must be non-null.
